message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake:

| Ingredient | Quantity (for a 9‑inch round cake) | Notes |
|------------|------------------------------------|-------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted for a lighter crumb |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | White or brown, depending on sweetness |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Dutch‑processed gives a richer flavor |
| Baking soda | 1 ½ tsp | Works with acidic cocoa for leavening |
| Baking powder | 1 ½ tsp | Adds extra lift |
| Salt | 1 ½ tsp | Balances sweetness |
| Eggs | 2 large | Room temperature |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) | Can substitute with almond or oat milk |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) | Or melted butter for richer taste |
| Vanilla extract | 2 tsp | Pure vanilla for depth |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Activates cocoa, keeps batter moist |
| Optional: 1–2 tbsp coffee |  | Enhances chocolate flavor |

**Optional add‑ons:**
- **Chocolate chips or chunks** (½ cup) for extra texture.
- **Whipped cream or frosting** (your choice) for topping.

Mix dry ingredients together, then combine wet ingredients separately. Add wet to dry, stir until just combined, then fold in boiling water (the batter will be thin). Bake at 350 °F (175 °C) for about 30–35 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean. Enjoy!
